headline: Your daily interpretation
summary: A fast-moving Scorpio Moon makes several squares and a conjunction to your Midheaven, while Mercury and Jupiter oppose your natal Moon and Mercury. This brings emotional intensity and mental restlessness to your work and self-expression. The stationary Pluto on your Aquarius Ascendant deepens this, urging you to transform how you show up without forcing outcomes. Simultaneously, Saturn in Gate 21 temporarily completes the Money Line, emphasizing stewardship of resources, and Neptune in Gate 25 touches your natal gate, softening boundaries. Mars in Gate 33 suggests retreat, not reaction. As a Projector with Emotional authority, wait for the invitation and ride the emotional wave before responding. The Moon's trine to Venus later offers a gentle way to connect. Use this time to observe rather than act, letting clarity emerge naturally.
